name: Sekai no Talk Show
source:
A beautiful female pro wrestler is hypnotized by a middle-aged man wearing a clown suit, and put under a suggestion spell.

As she features on a live talk show, he gives her various lewd instructions.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ032440.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
一位美丽的职业女子摔跤手，被身穿小丑服的中年男子催眠，并被施加了心理暗示。

在她参加一档直播脱口秀时，男子向她下达了各种淫猥的指令。
